notes: Sideways aim now uses the right distance (the distance you say, else the aim marker or the flag) and asks for a "yes" before a very big turn. Say "Caddie, I'm done" (or your own phrase) to throw the club. Give each player a nickname the caddie uses. Common mishearings of Caddie (Paddy, Daddy, Addy) are accepted before a command. Microphone level meter warns when the sound is too loud. The command list can be printed or saved as a one-page PDF.
